name: ibis Apartadó
desc: Apartadó is the most populated municipality in the subregion of Urabá in Antioquia, Colombia, known as the "Capital of Urabá" or "Emporium of Banana Wealth". Its economy is based primarily on banana production, with a diversified economy that also includes livestock, commerce and services. Its municipal seat is about 190 miles from Medellín and is known for its commercial infrastructure and diverse cultural mix.
